matchupOfTheWeek.title: Pass Defense vs. Pass Offense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our pass defense grades 90/100 (among the NFL's best) against LV's pass offense at 68/100 (above average) — the widest statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Here's the thing that should make Patriots fans sleep soundly this week: we've got the league's best pass defense squaring off against Vegas's merely above-average pass offense, and that's the widest statistical edge anywhere on the board. Drake Maye just earned AFC Offensive Player of the Week after leading a 29-26 comeback against Buffalo—so our momentum is real, even if we've been treading water at break-even in our last three games overall. The nightmare scenario, though, is our run defense (23/100, bottom-tier) getting absolutely shredded by a Las Vegas team that's actually been slightly better than us in recent form, while Rhamondre Stevenson's injury creates questions we're not thrilled about. Our pass protection grades at 35/100 against their 90/100 pass rush could make life difficult for Maye on the road—well, in Foxborough, technically, but you get it. This is a game where our defense needs to dominate early and often, because our offense has some serious limitations this week.
